facts.fact: 沃克在走廊拦住 KRAY，说十六点要向国会山的两名 Staffers 做简报，并邀他同行。
facts.anchor: We’re briefing a couple Staffers from the Hill at sixteen hundred hours.

facts.fact: 沃克让 KRAY 十五点四十五分到 Front Office，大家一起去。
facts.anchor: Come on by the Front Office at fifteen forty-five. We’ll all troop over together.

facts.fact: KLIMT 说预计能在财年第四季度按时、按预算达成数字指标。
facts.anchor: We project bein’ able to meet our numerical numbers on time and under budget by the fourth quarter a the fiscal year.

facts.fact: KLIMT 说国家档案馆搬迁一项就给西弗吉尼亚带来四万四千多名新居民。
facts.anchor: the National Archives relocation alone brought in more’n forty-four thousand brand-new residents of West Virginia.

facts.fact: 库珀自报来自纽约市，并问 KRAY 是哪里人。
facts.anchor: My name’s Cooper. I’m from New York City. Where do you hail from?

facts.fact: 库珀离场时低声让 KRAY 去走廊左侧的男厕所见他。
facts.anchor: Meet me in the Men’s Room out in the hallway on the left.

facts.fact: 库珀递给 KRAY 的名片上印着 DEAN BRETT COOPER。
facts.anchor: Printed on it in capital letters was the name DEAN BRETT COOPER.

facts.fact: 沃克说库珀只在这里干了十年，海外干得还行，但做不了总部管理，是个撂挑子的人。
facts.anchor: Only for ten years. Went overseas, did all right there, I guess. Couldn’t handle being a manager at Headquarters though. Didn’t have what it takes. Quitter.
